definitions.explanation: A metal with a high density, such as lead, mercury, or cadmium; often discussed as a cause of pollution.

⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{重金属|じゅうきんぞく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{検出|けんしゅつ}→検出：13132_kenshutsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: Heavy metals such as mercury and cadmium harm health when they build up in the body.

notes:
A science and environment term. In Japan it is closely associated with the pollution diseases of the 1950s–60s, such as {水俣病|みなまたびょう} (mercury poisoning).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重金属|じゅうきんぞく}⟦{汚染|おせん}→汚染：02595_osen⟧: heavy-metal pollution
- {重金属|じゅうきんぞく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{含|ふく}む→含む：01982_fukumu⟧: to contain heavy metals
